42 cookie cutters for the shop’s year

Every shape on this page is drawn as code and exported as a print-ready STL: the six house pastries, a collection for each season from Saint-Valentin to New Year in Pasadena, and a « merci » stamp plate.

42 files · 523 g of filament for the full set · 0.8 mm blades, 15 mm tall, 4 mm finger flange

Printing them food-safe

  • Food-contact PETG or PLA through a stainless nozzle used for nothing else; 0.2 mm layers, 2 walls, no supports.
  • Hand wash in lukewarm water, dry fully, never the dishwasher.
  • Cling film between cutter and dough, or a cured food-grade epoxy coat (FDA 21 CFR 175.300).
  • Replace a cutter once its layer lines discolour or the blade chips.

Design board, 2026-10-22. Files live beside this page, one folder per season; each STL has a sidecar with its parameters and a checksum. Filament weights assume PLA at 1.24 g/cm³; print times assume 60 mm/s and leave out travel and heat-up.
